norm condition

  • CURIE: gmeow:normCondition
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/normCondition
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The condition under which this norm applies. NOT functional: several conditions on one norm are an implicit conjunction; use a gmeow:ConditionGroup when the combination logic matters.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Norm -> gmeow:Condition

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:normCondition from gmeow:Norm to gmeow:Condition when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Norm, gmeow:Condition

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to name the condition(s) under which a norm applies.

Avoid when

  • Avoid relying on multiple bare conditions when the combination logic matters (several conditions are an implicit conjunction — use a gmeow:ConditionGroup for any/none/nested trees).

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:normCondition from the norm to one or more gmeow:Condition nodes; wrap them in a gmeow:ConditionGroup when you need explicit and/or/not.

Examples

  • ex:n1 gmeow:normCondition ex:c1.
